name: devflow-ai
description: Multi-agent software development team: backlog selection, confirmed assignment, requirements, implementation, QA, review, and approved issue tracker updates (GitHub Issues or Jira).

COMPLIANCE_MODE.title: Compliance mode
COMPLIANCE_MODE.description: Set hipaa for PHI-safe workflows (feature/hipaa-compliance branch)

WORK_ITEM_PROVIDER.title: Work item provider
WORK_ITEM_PROVIDER.description: Primary issue tracker for DevFlow commands

GITHUB_OWNER.title: GitHub owner
GITHUB_OWNER.description: Organization or user for the repository (e.g. karthik3494)

GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub token
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: PAT with repo scope for issues (issues:read/write as needed); set only in Plugins → Configure

JIRA_SITE_NAME.title: Jira site name (subdomain)
JIRA_SITE_NAME.description: Optional for Jira. Subdomain only for jira-cloud MCP

JIRA_PROJECT_KEY.title: Default Jira project key
JIRA_PROJECT_KEY.description: Optional default project for Jira backlog
